# Dheeraj Kumar Shukla

> Solution Architect (Greater Noida, India) with 14+ years designing cloud-native, enterprise-grade platforms on .NET and Azure/AWS — specializing in EV charging interoperability (OCPI 2.2.1, OCPP, Beckn BAP/BPP), IoT messaging (MQTT, RabbitMQ), microservices, CI/CD, ERP integration, and enterprise AI architecture (LLMs, RAG, Azure OpenAI). Currently a Solution Architect in the EV sector (since May 2026; employer not publicly disclosed). Previously Technical Architect at TechPerspect Software (ElectreeFi), Aug 2023 – Apr 2026, where he was technical SPOC for Hyundai, Mahindra, Tata, Adani, and Hero MotoCorp.

Key facts:
- 14+ years in software engineering; 9+ years in .NET Core and microservices
- 99% platform uptime on EV charging systems; interoperability improved 20%
- Integrated 30+ CPO/eMSP networks; IoT platform scaled to 2000+ devices and 1M+ daily user interactions
- Product-side ownership: roadmap, PRDs/FRDs, backlog prioritisation, KPI tracking, stakeholder alignment
- Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
- Contact: dheerajshuk@gmail.com · +91-9136075015

## OCPI 2.2.1 module deep dives

- [OCPI Versions: the handshake before the handshake](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-versions-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): version negotiation, the endpoint directory, and sender vs receiver roles
- [OCPI Credentials: the registration handshake](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-credentials-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the Token A/B/C dance, the roles array, rotation and revocation
- [OCPI Commands: remote control across company lines](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-commands-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): all five commands, the two-phase async pattern, timeouts and correlation
- [OCPI ChargingProfiles: smart charging across parties](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-charging-profiles-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the SCSP role, profile anatomy, and how it maps onto OCPP
- [OCPI HubClientInfo: knowing who is online](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-hub-client-info-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): hub topology, the four status values, and routing without hurting drivers

## OCPI commands (one page per command)

- [OCPI START_SESSION: remote start, end to end](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-start-session-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the async flow, EVSE targeting, failure modes and a production-safe sequence
- [OCPI STOP_SESSION: ending a charge remotely](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-stop-session-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): why session_id is the only identifier, and the race against natural session end
- [OCPI RESERVE_NOW: holding a charger before arrival](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-reserve-now-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): expiry design, location vs EVSE level, and the commercial reality of reservations
- [OCPI CANCEL_RESERVATION: releasing a hold](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-cancel-reservation-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the CANCELED_RESERVATION result, UNKNOWN_RESERVATION, and why cancelling matters
- [OCPI UNLOCK_CONNECTOR: releasing a latched cable](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-unlock-connector-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): why cables latch, why CPOs disable it, and how to design the driver flow

## Beckn protocol (actions and concepts)

- [Beckn search: discovery on the open network](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-search-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the intent object, broadcast fan-out, and streaming results
- [Beckn select: turning a listing into a quote](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-select-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): building the order, reading the quote breakup, re-checking availability
- [Beckn init: billing, terms and the draft order](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-init-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): payment types, cancellation terms, and why init is separate
- [Beckn confirm: creating the order](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-confirm-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): order creation, the authorization token, and mandatory idempotency
- [Beckn status: tracking an active order](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-status-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): fulfilment states, unsolicited pushes, live charging progress
- [Beckn update: changing an order in flight](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-update-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): update_target, stopping a charge, provider-initiated updates
- [Beckn cancel: ending an order before fulfilment](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-cancel-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): reason codes, fees bound to state, bpp-initiated cancellation
- [Beckn context: the envelope every message shares](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-context-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): transaction_id vs message_id, ttl, and correlation rules
- [Beckn signing and the registry](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-signing-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): ed25519 signatures, subscriber lookup, and the trust model
- [The Beckn gateway: broadcast discovery](https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-gateway-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): fan-out, why it leaves after search, and ack/nack

## OCPP (message by message)

- [OCPP BootNotification: how a charger comes online](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-boot-notification-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): registration, accepted/pending/rejected, and fleet inventory
- [OCPP Heartbeat: liveness and clock sync](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-heartbeat-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): interval tuning, clock drift, and why ping is not a substitute
- [OCPP StatusNotification: what the connector is doing](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-status-notification-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): nine states, error codes, connectorid 0, and ocpi mapping
- [OCPP Authorize: deciding who may charge](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-authorize-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): idtaginfo, local lists, cache, and offline policy
- [OCPP StartTransaction: opening a session](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-start-transaction-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): meterstart, transaction ids, and offline queuing
- [OCPP MeterValues: the numbers billing runs on](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-meter-values-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): measurands, sampling intervals, and validation
- [OCPP StopTransaction: closing the books](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-stop-transaction-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): meterstop, stop reasons, and reconciliation
- [OCPP RemoteStartTransaction: behind every app tap](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-remote-start-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): connector targeting and why accepted confirms nothing
- [OCPP RemoteStopTransaction: stopping from the cloud](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-remote-stop-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): the race against natural session end
- [OCPP TransactionEvent: the 2.0.1 rewrite](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-transaction-event-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): triggerreason, seqno, and migrating from 1.6j
- [OCPP smart charging: shaping power at the charger](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-smart-charging-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): profile stacks, purposes, and getcompositeschedule
- [OCPP configuration: reading and changing settings](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-configuration-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): key settings, rebootrequired, and configuration drift
- [OCPP firmware and diagnostics](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-firmware-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): staged rollout, bricking risk, and update discipline
- [OCPP Reset and availability control](https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-reset-by-dheeraj-shukla.html): soft vs hard reset, and safe remote intervention
